composition.badge: One solid dark red circle, centered, filling approximately 85% of the canvas. The area outside the circle must be fully transparent.
composition.pictogram: One compact tied bundle of banknotes, centered inside the circle, filling approximately 55% of the circle. Show the bundle as a single object: a slightly rounded stack with one broad paper band around the middle. Use a bold, simple silhouette that remains readable when printed small.
composition.alignment: Perfectly centered horizontally and vertically, with generous clear space around the pictogram.

style: Flat two-color board-game category icon. Clean vector-like edges, no gradients, no shadows, no texture, no outline beyond the white silhouette.
constraints: Use only the dark red badge color and white pictogram color.
No currency symbols, numbers, letters, logos, coins, hands, people, buildings, or extra objects.
The banknotes and their paper band must read as one tied bundle, not several separate items.
No transparency holes inside the dark red circle except where required by the white pictogram itself.
Keep the entire badge inside the canvas with transparent padding on all sides.
